value.rationale: The natural integer GCD of two neighboring points on a binary cubic-sum surface has a complete attainable-value classification, a strict positive-density realization for each allowed integer, and a limiting law with infinite mean. The exact local dichotomy (six smooth roots at primes 1 mod 3, zero at other odd primes, and dyadic exponent at most three) explains an arithmetic structure not inferable from general polynomial-GCD existence statements alone. It is an infinite-family structural theorem with natural invariant and future relevance to shifted polynomial-value GCD problems.
